narration.text: Why cleanup removed only 0.5% of the garbage patch.
The patch covers 1.6 million square kilometres.
That's about three times the size of France.
It holds 45,000 to 129,000 tonnes of plastic.
By mass, 92% is larger objects, not microplastics.
Some of the plastic is over 50 years old.
Stopping new plastic matters more than scooping old plastic.
So the patch isn't an island. It's a slow, spreading soup.
